reviews.text:
I called Pedro to help me with Bob's separation anxiety, and in less than a month, I can already see improvements!

Pedro helped me see several things I was doing wrong with Bob for the past 7 years, many of them without even realizing it. Even when my questions seem simple or obvious, whenever I need help with a situation, he is very helpful, attentive, and willing to guide me.

I highly recommend his work! ❤️
Pedro is excellent, very friendly, and won over my Cavapoo. She learned new commands, and he helped us understand how to continue teaching her training and new commands. I recommend him.

I would like to express my gratitude to Pedro for the excellent work he did with our puppy, Lorrain, a 4-month-old American Pit Bull Terrier.

When we started training, our goal was to teach him the basics and provide a good foundation for his development. Today, at the end of the lessons, we can say it was well worth it. Lorrain learned commands like sit, stay, and wait, improved significantly in potty training, and also learned to walk without pulling on the leash.

Pedro was always very patient, calm, and attentive, respecting Lorrain's learning pace and also teaching us how to act in each situation. In addition to the lessons, he shared various guidelines and recommended products that made a difference in our routine with the puppy.

Another point worth highlighting is his professionalism. He was always punctual, organized, and very committed to the process.

I wholeheartedly recommend Pedro's work to anyone looking for a trainer who truly cares about the dog's well-being and guiding the whole family. We are certain that Lorrain started life with an excellent foundation thanks to his work. Thank you so much for everything!

Excellent professional! My dogs used to fight a lot and were very aggressive, but now they are much more balanced and can handle frustration better. I am very satisfied with the result! Congratulations on your professionalism 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻
Pedro is being incredible in training Senna! I highly recommend him! He has so much love for what he does! ✨

I'm training my foxhound, who is 4 months old today, and the experience with Pedro has been excellent. She's a very energetic dog and was separated from her mother very early, at only 1 month old, which makes adapting to apartment life quite challenging.

Pedro has been with us throughout this journey: basic obedience commands, walks, recommendations for suitable toys, and building healthy habits and routines for her. The work has been very positive and has made a huge difference in our daily lives. I highly recommend him!

Amazing service! I called Pedro to help me as soon as my puppy arrived, and it was the best decision. Receiving help and guidance from someone who understands dogs and allows for efficient communication between owner and animal – which makes living together much more enjoyable and functional – was essential. Pedro is very kind, and Lumi adores him. Thank you so much!
Based on the level of feedback, I expected better service. I made all the plans with the intention of hiring them, but they left me high and dry.

I went to Pedro so he could correct my dog's reactivity! We had a few lessons and he always helped me whenever necessary. Today my dog ​​is a different dog! He accepts being near others without trying to lunge, and walks go much better! I can only thank him!!
Excellent professional, always very attentive to my questions, and even after completing the entire training process, he continues to help me with tips when I have doubts.

Pedro is a fantastic dog trainer; if your dog has separation anxiety, Pedro will help you solve that! Just like he helped me with Bart!

Besides that, he's an extremely kind and good person... I highly recommend his work.

Excellent Professional, Highly Recommend!
Pedro is an extremely competent professional, very patient and caring with Tutu and Simba.
I sought training because Simba was very reactive with animals and people, pulled a lot on walks, and I also needed to adapt Tutu, whom I had just adopted. With the suggested changes, everything evolved very quickly, in less than a year! Simba greatly improved his reactivity and no longer pulls as before - it ensured that the two got along well and also helped with Tutu's adaptation regarding his needs.
Pedro was excellent! He helped and taught us a lot during my dachshund puppy's first few months. I highly recommend him!

Pedro is a wonderful trainer. Tobias used to be very timid – he was afraid of going for walks, of other dogs, of strangers, of his own shadow, etc. Today, he's a very confident little dog, he plays in the park with all the other dogs, makes friends on the street, I can take him to restaurants and shopping malls and he behaves super well. He learned to do his business in the right place, to sit, lie down, and come when called. Now we're working on the command for him to go to his bed. What I liked most about Pedro's work was his patience in working with Tobias according to his personality and needs, and in explaining how to continue the training during the week. I 100% recommend him!
Pedro was super patient, loves dogs, and understands their language. Plus, he taught me a lot while training my dog!

Pedro has always been very caring and patient with the dogs! You can see how much he loves his profession, and that's essential for the results. In one month, my dog, who used to be super aggressive on walks, can now walk calmly and enjoy the walk – it's amazing! I highly recommend him! Thank you, Uncle Pedro!!

I want to leave my review of the trainer's work. The training was conducted with great professionalism, patience, and knowledge. From the beginning, it was possible to perceive the dedication and care in understanding the animal's behavior, applying efficient and respectful techniques.

I recommend the work without a doubt to anyone looking for serious, responsible training with excellent results.

Pedro and his team are excellent!

I adopted my dog ​​when he was already an adult, and his relationship with the cats was very bad. In two months, with the help of IntegraCão, we managed to improve their relationship significantly, bringing peace back to our home.

I recommend them without hesitation!

It was an excellent experience. Pedro is very competent, friendly, and explains in detail how to proceed with the puppy. I knew nothing, and he patiently explained everything I needed to know. Congratulations, Pedro! 👏👏👏 …

Excellent professional who overflows with love for animals! He guided my husband and me in a practical way, and we achieved results much faster than we imagined! I recommend him wholeheartedly and with a super happy heart. My border collies were fighting (hurting each other), and I was extremely frustrated! Pedro was a blessing!
Excellent professional! Fast and effective results. Thank you and we recommend them!

Pedro is an unparalleled professional! I was able to count on all his professionalism and experience during the arrival of my golden retriever puppy and his adaptation to my Shih Tzu. And the unthinkable happened, siblings who barely touched each other now live together. We did a lot of research and found the right professional! We recommend Pedro without hesitation!
Want a well-behaved puppy that does its business in the right place, walks without pulling, and only brings joy? Call Pedro!

Tobias and I are so grateful to Pedro for his kindness, politeness, and the care he showed Tobias. Pedro suggested activities to do with Tobias to help with his anxiety and separation anxiety, as Tobias was having trouble being alone. He also helped with walks with Tobias, since he pulled a lot, and the best part was recommending toys that Tobias approved of and loved. I can only express my gratitude!

Excellent service, follow-up, and attention!

My pet has made amazing progress.
Pedro was very attentive and polite. Our pet, Macallan, has made great progress on walks and has stopped pulling desperately on the leash. We've noticed a big difference since his obedience training.

Pedro was with us during our puppy's first few months at home. He was extremely patient and attentive with both him and us. Our dog likes him so much that he would cry when Pedro arrived for the lesson, hahaha. I highly recommend him!

I sought out Pedro after I started having behavioral and reactivity problems with Jack, who was lunging at people, especially in the building's elevator.
From the initial assessment, Pedro was extremely attentive and professional. He managed to connect very well with Jack, who even looked forward to the training sessions.
I received all the necessary assistance to understand, anticipate, and manage behaviors and situations that could trigger reactions, even though Jack didn't give many prior signs. Walks became much more peaceful, and he learned new commands, in addition to reinforcing the ones he already knew.
Pedro also helped expose Jack to different scenarios that were previously uncomfortable for him, always in a careful and gradual way, which made all the difference in the process.

I highly recommend his work!

Pedro is an excellent professional, very attentive, dedicated, and patient. He always suggested great solutions for my dog's bad habits and helped improve many positive aspects. I highly recommend him.
Very good!! It helps a lot in keeping my Spitz from barking and helps him do his business in the right place! An excellent investment for living with your dog.
The training sessions with Pedro were great. In a short time, our dog improved a lot!!!

My brother, thank you for your support these past months. Emily is a different person, I mean, a different dog. lol
A super energetic little golden retriever who learned how to behave.
I highly recommend her! Great people! Super partner! Thanks Pedro!

Given the good reviews, I became very interested in the job and contacted them for more information.
After a few exchanges of messages, they viewed my message with questions and did not respond.
Two weeks later I messaged again to continue the conversation, they viewed it and again did not respond. So I gave up :(

Pedro is simply amazing with dogs. Besides teaching various commands and techniques for dealing with behavioral problems, my dogs are genuinely happy just to see him arrive! They love Pedro! I highly recommend his work! Excellent professional!
We love Pedro, Toddy is so happy when he arrives! And he's already learned so much in such a short time. Very good, I recommend him!!!

Pedro is very careful with the dogs and is committed to treating them as family members, considering the limits and demands necessary for good coexistence between humans and dogs. I really enjoyed the training; it was simple and effective. We will continue the process with Faísca soon. He is already much calmer on walks and at home, and I've learned new ways to communicate with him, based on Pedro's lessons. I want to continue the training so that Faísca can also be calm with more stimuli and so we can be in places with pet areas, for example, restaurants, etc. 🐺🐶💛✨

Pedro worked with Brando for three months, and the progress our Brando made was incredible. He was very attentive and patient, and also gave us tips for everyday care. It was definitely a great choice, and our family thanks him for his work!

My experience with IntegraCão was excellent! Pedro is a super professional, very dedicated, and the connection with my dog ​​was immediate! I had hired other professionals before, and there's no comparison! IntegraCão's service is impeccable!! I highly recommend them!!

Pedro is excellent and very attentive. He quickly bonded with the dogs, which greatly helped their development and learning. Understanding commands, managing anxiety, and improving walks were some of the things we worked on, and all the lessons were a great learning experience. I highly recommend him!

Pedro is an amazing professional!! The results are significant and my dogs love the training sessions; it's super fun for them.

I recommend him to anyone who needs a little help with their dog. My walks are much more peaceful, as is my daily life.

It's totally worth it!!
Excellent professional, dedicated, careful with animals and very responsible. I recommend him.

We only have good things to say about our experience with IntegraCão! We sought out Pedro because our dogs were very anxious and walks were becoming increasingly difficult. In a short time, the difference was enormous: they became much calmer, more focused, and we also learned a lot from the whole process.

Pedro is incredible—super nice, patient, and attentive to the dogs and to us. He always explained everything simply, answered our questions, and helped us better understand their behavior. You can see that he truly cares about the animals and the relationship between owner and dog.

It was a very positive journey for us as owners and for our furry friends too. We are very happy with the results and will certainly recommend him to anyone who needs help with dog training!
Pedro is very attentive and capable; he managed to teach my 8-year-old gentleman super fast!
Pedro is an extremely competent professional and a very pleasant companion! Our dog improved a lot with the training and guidance, I highly recommend him!

Thank you for your feedback, Victor.

We at IntegraCão are specialists in dog training in São Paulo, offering a personalized and efficient service. We strategically plan each training session to provide balanced behavior, obedience, and well-being for your pet.
Excellent trainer, very caring and attentive to the specific needs of each dog.
Excellent service! You can trust that he is a caring, competent, and honest professional.
Excellent professional and very attentive! We noticed an improvement in our dog's behavior after just a few sessions. We highly recommend them!

Pedro's work was excellent for Charlotte.
I recommend him.

IntegraCão is excellent, it helped me a lot with my little ones, and they're already older dogs. They like Pedro so much that whenever I arrive at the park near my house where we train, they can't see someone sitting on a bench without thinking it's him. I highly recommend him! You can't go wrong, a great professional!

Pedro is an excellent trainer; his interaction with my dog ​​is fantastic. He has a lot of patience, affection, and respect for his students. My Hound has improved a lot in a short time; for a stubborn breed, Pedro is doing an excellent job. Another point to mention is that Woody is always happy when he's with Pedro... I highly recommend him.
Bebel loved learning so much from Pedro. He was very attentive, punctual, and excellent at his job. We saw great results with Bebel.
I highly recommend training with Pedro. Bart improved a lot in the first few lessons, Pedro is super attentive and patient, and it was definitely an excellent experience!!

Excellent training!

The results were very good! …
Pedro is an excellent professional. He is very attentive and patient with pets, and he also shares valuable tips for our daily lives.
Malu had several trainers, and we even thought there was no hope. But Pedro was an excellent trainer, very affectionate and careful, essential for Malu, who is very anxious and reactive. …
Pedro is excellent and knows dogs very well; this synergy has helped me immensely to learn more about how to handle my pet. I've seen great progress in just a few months. I highly recommend him!
Pedro helped us so much with our two dogs!! Super patient and attentive, he took the utmost care of them and adapted the training to our needs. I highly recommend him.

My dog ​​didn't like going for walks.

With just a few lessons, Pedro not only managed to make him enjoy walks but also …
